title: Very good treatment, excellent experience.
text: Very good experience, my wife and I do not usually hire tours or guides, we do everything on our own, but from now on Amigos Tours will be our #1 choice. The guide Sara explained everything we needed to know about the Sagrada Familia perfectly and her treatment was very kind and professional.

title: Very informative. Tour guides are fun and knowledgeable!
text: As someone who enjoys trivia, I highly recommend Marta/Martha who gave us a very informative tour of Park Guell. We were only 5 in the english tour but still she gave her best effort complete with pictures for us to learn more about the park. It is amazing to learn things that i wont know/pay attention if we just came there by ourselves. My mom is actually impressed with her so she told me to give a little something from Philippines. Hope to still see you around 2033 once sagrada is finished!
